core_logic: 6-question quiz calculates a surrogate FICO-SBSS score to bypass traditional gatekeepers. 132

title: The "Mentorship ROI Accelerator"
problem: Coaches lose 30% of $10k mastermind sales because students lack upfront liquidity. 131, 132
core_logic: Shows how 0% credit stacking lets students pay $200/mo while using $10k for ad-spend fuel. 132

title: The TikTok Viral Curse Predictor
problem: Predicts suspension risk (Late Dispatch Rate) during viral surges.
input_fields: Units Sold (Last 48hr), Current Cash on Hand, Supplier Cost/Unit
core_logic: Score = Cash / (Units Sold * Cost)

title: The "Section 179" Tax Slash Tool
problem: Calculates Q4 tax savings of financing new equipment.
input_fields: Cost of Equipment ($), Est. Tax Bracket (%)
core_logic: Net Cost = Equipment Cost - (Cost * Tax Bracket)

title: The Gig Income Funding Predictor
problem: Shows funding potential for drivers based on app activity.
input_fields: Avg Weekly Earnings, Platform (Uber/DoorDash), Years Driving
core_logic: Max Funding = Avg Earnings * 4 (modified by seniority)

title: The "Runway Death Clock"
problem: Agitates the fear of running out of cash before the next milestone.
input_fields: 1. Cash in bank 2. Monthly Burn Rate 3. MoM Revenue Growth %
core_logic: (Cash) / (Burn - (MRR * Growth)) to find the exact month cash hits $0.
output: The "Zero Hour" Dashboard: A giant red countdown clock showing the exact month and year they run out of money.

title: The "CAC Payback Analyzer"
problem: Tests if their marketing engine is bankable.
input_fields: 1. Monthly Ad Spend 2. New Customers Added 3. ARPU; 4. Gross Margin %
core_logic: CAC = Spend/Customers. Payback = CAC / (ARPU * Margin). Evaluates if < 6 months.
output: The "Bankability Scale" PDF: A visual dial (Red/Yellow/Green) scoring their capital efficiency.

title: The Term Sheet "Toxicity"
problem: Scanner. Educates founders on predatory VC terms.
input_fields: Checkboxes for: 1x/2x Liquidation Pref, Participating Preferred, Full Ratchet, Pro-Rata.
core_logic: Assigns a negative multiplier to the founder's exit value for every toxic term selected.
output: The "Toxicity Score" Checklist: A graded report (A to F) showing how predatory their current term sheet is.

title: The "Trapped Cash" Calculator
problem: Agitates the pain of Net 60/90 invoice delays.
input_fields: 1. Monthly B2B Invoiced 2. Avg Days to Get Paid 3. Monthly OpEx
core_logic: (Invoiced Volume / 30) * Days to Pay. Calculates working capital deficit.
output: The "Missing Millions" Report: A bar chart showing how much of their cash is trapped in AR.

title: The Fundability Scorecard
problem: The ultimate self-qualification tool for your ecosystem.
input_fields: 1. ARR 2. YoY Growth % 3. Gross Margin % 4. Net Revenue Retention
core_logic: Weighted scoring matrix. >80 = Prime, 50-79 = Incubator, <50 = Unfundable.
output: The "Lender's Eye" Score: A personalized teardown of the metrics keeping them from getting funded.

title: The Debt vs. Equity Showdown
problem: A direct comparison tool for growth rounds.
input_fields: 1. Capital Needed 2. Current Val 3. Est. Exit Val 4. Debt Interest Rate
core_logic: Compares (Exit Val * VC Dilution) against (Exit Val - Principal - Interest).
output: The "Net Wealth" Chart: A side-by-side bar chart of their take-home pay at exit.

title: The SaaS LTV:CAC Diagnostic
problem: Finds the golden gooses who don't realize they are golden.
core_logic: LTV = ARPU / Churn. Divides LTV by CAC. Checks if ratio is > 3:1.
output: The "Growth Engine" Gauge: Visualizes if their business is a leaky bucket or a compounding asset.

title: The "Cost of a Board Seat"
problem: EstimatorQuantifies the hidden, non-financial cost of VC.
input_fields: 1. Founder Hourly Value 2. Hours Prep for Board 3. Monthly Legal/Audit Fees
core_logic: (Founder Rate * Prep Hours * 12) + (Fees * 12). Calculates wasted resources.
output: The "Boss Tax" Invoice: A fake, customized invoice showing what they pay annually just to manage their VC board.

title: The True APR Revealer
problem: Exposes predatory lenders by calculating effective APR.
input_fields: 1. Loan Amount 2. Stated Interest Rate 3. Origination Fee % 4. Warrant Coverage %
core_logic: Converts hidden fees and warrants into an annualized percentage rate.
output: The "Unmasked Rate" Summary: Shows the delta between the "advertised" rate and the real mathematical rate.

title: The Exit Waterfall Simulator
problem: Shows who gets paid first when the company sells.
input_fields: 1. Exit Price 2. Total Debt 3. VC Pref Equity 4. Founder Pool %
core_logic: subtracts debt, subtracts preferred return, then allocates the remaining common pool.
output: The "Waterfall" Diagram: A step-by-step visual of the cash trickling down (or drying up before it hits the founder).
